summary: The diff implements REQ-140 by adding a new OcarinaCarousel component and modifying Marketplace.tsx to replace the search bar with the carousel. Most acceptance criteria appear to be met: search bar removed, carousel added using useGetProducts hook, cards show image/title/description/pitch scale, Play Demo with loading indicator, Play Ocarina button, Buy Now navigation, and remaining Marketplace sections preserved. However, the OcarinaCarousel.tsx file is truncated so some details cannot be fully verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: The OcarinaPanel includes a close/dismiss control.
missing_requirements.reason: The OcarinaCarousel.tsx diff is truncated and the section rendering the OcarinaPanel is not visible, so there is no evidence that a close/dismiss control is implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: Price display (A$xx.xx) on each carousel card
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specifies carousel cards should show product image, title, description, and assigned pitch scale only. Displaying the price was not requested.
